# Pulse 1.0.389 🚀

## 🎨 Extra apps: Material glass icons
- 🪟 Material glass is now an optional icon look: for all extra apps at once, or one app at a time.
- 🎚️ Three glass strengths: Soft, Vivid (default) and More vivid.
- 🎨 Material colour presets, plus a custom colour picker (saturation, brightness and hue).
- 💜 Pulse's own icon is now its heartbeat line.
- ⌨️ The Keyboard icon is now just the keys, without letters.

## 🎮 Game Hub
- 🔎 "Look for covers" runs in the background, with a notification showing progress and a Stop button.

🔧 Build fix: a visibility error in the cover search code was fixed.
